description:
The Bad Granny frameset is about longevity, consistency and riding without ceremony. It exists for riders who value robustness over trends and who want a bike that becomes part of everyday life rather than a special occasion.

From the first ride, the Bad Granny feels solid and reassuring. Geometry supports an upright, balanced riding position that encourages comfort across time rather than speed over distance. Handling remains stable and predictable, making the bike easy to live with across varied surfaces and conditions.

Acceleration is smooth and measured. The bike isn’t in a hurry—but it never resists being ridden. Whether loaded lightly or ridden day after day, the frameset feels dependable and composed.

Like all other models, the frameset shares its complete design with the finished bike. Nothing is reduced or simplified. What is left open is how the rider chooses to use it.

The Bad Granny is built around the assumption that bikes are used often, in less‑than‑perfect conditions, and with minimal fuss. Stability, durability and comfort are the defining characteristics.

The frame absorbs surface variability without muting feedback entirely. The ride remains communicative while reducing long‑term fatigue, making it well suited to everyday riding and extended ownership.

Choosing the frameset gives riders control over components without requiring constant reconsideration. The Bad Granny accepts different drivetrains, equipment levels and configurations without shifting its core personality.

It adapts, but it doesn’t reinvent itself.

Every Bad Granny frameset is finished individually. Frame size, colour and selected options are defined during ordering before the frame is assembled and prepared in our workshop. The result is a frame that feels ready to be lived with.

The Bad Granny frameset isn’t exciting in a fleeting way. It’s reassuring. It’s for riders who want to build a bike once and ride it often—for years.

A durable, everyday frameset.Defined by reliability, comfort and long‑term use.Curated for riders who value trust over trends and riding over replacement.

All Sour Bicycles frames are made by hand, one-by-one, in our own facility in Saxony, just outside of Dresden. We use custom tubing designed and drawn for our frames, it’s a multi-butted heat-treated CrMo steel that’s ready to stand the test of time. Our steel tubes come from specialised tube makers in Taiwan and Europe – custom drawn, multi-butted and partly heat-treated to our own specifications. Every frame is then welded by hand in our workshop in Saxony.

Our dropouts are designed in-house in Dresden and have a replaceable derailleur hanger.

The seat clamp is designed in-house and is integrated into the frame. Should it ever fail, the frame can be professionally modified to use a traditional clamp, if repair of the original clamp is not possible. We have never seen one fail.

To protect the inside of the frame, we always apply a wax coating, we do this to all Sour frames. However, the outside of the frame and parts will be left raw. To preserve these parts, we will provide a bottle of Sour Frame Oil, a perfect blend of love and linseed oil.

Axle: 15mm x 110mm Boost thru axleBrake standard: PM7″ disc brakeTapered Steerer Tube 1½” – 1⅛”Rake: 50mmFork length: 490mmMax. tire dimension 29“ x 2.4“4 eyelets per fork leg

The order window will be open for 14 days maximum.

Below are the frame and fork weights for each size of the Sour Bad Granny. These weights do not include powdercoating, but please keep in mind that your chosen powdercoat may be heavier than the average coating we use. Fades, gradients, and metallic colours can weigh more than single solid colour powdercoat. If you are interested the final weight, please get in touch. Weights are averaged over three frames per size. We apply a wax coating on the inside of the frame for rust prevention, this will also add a small amount of weight.

Frameweights incl. small parts

Included with your limited Bad Granny frameset is all the small parts to run any cabling you wish and a derailleur hanger. You get a rear thru-axle and a front axle with your fork as well. Headsets are not included in your order but if you need one right away give us a shout!
